items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked. Keep SearchWoot private. Woot documentation confirms API access but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, or alert on returned data; public terms point against commercial/public data use. Security, accuracy/freshness, attribution, measurement, privacy, and owner gates remain incomplete. No go-live recommendation is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active with zero tasks closed this cycle. Evidence progress: authoritative Woot terms and API documentation are recorded; data-flow and privacy artifacts are partial; no permission, retention/deletion, processor, GA4-settings, or incident-procedure evidence has closed a task. Next evidence action: produce the read-only data-flow/retention table and operator/vendor inventory, then attach the resulting artifacts to the four open checklist tasks.

Data-use dispositions: Woot deal and price-history data: blocked pending written rights and field-level terms; next action is prepare an unsent permission request for owner review. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed pending data inventory, retention, deletion/correction, processor terms, and unsubscribe evidence; next action is document the deployed flow. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed pending consent behavior, property/data-sharing settings, retention, and jurisdiction review; next action is capture read-only configuration evidence. Operational logs and Cloudflare data: evidence_needed pending log fields, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures; next action is produce the operator/vendor inventory.
